description.value: James Bay Coffee House is a neighbourhood café in Victoria's historic James Bay district, steps from the Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park — a well-travelled area for cycling tourists exploring the city. It opened in September 2025, making it a fresh addition to the local café scene. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find it a convenient stop in a walkable, bike-friendly part of downtown Victoria.
